## Key Financial Figures (December 31, 2013)

- **Professional Fees**: $183 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)
- **Total Reorganization Items, Net**: $2,429 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)
- **Fair Value of Conversion Discount**: $201 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)
- **Aircraft and Facility Financing Renegotiations and Rejections**: $294 million (Source: `documents/report.md`)

### Portion of Total Net Reorganization Items Related to Professional Fees

The portion of the total net reorganization items that are related to professional fees is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Professional Fees}}{\text{Total Reorganization Items, Net}} = \frac{183}{2,429} \approx 0.0753 \]

This means that approximately 7.53% of the total net reorganization items are related to professional fees.

- All figures are sourced from the audited 10-K report (`documents/report.md`).

|---|---|
